opponents.name: Gambler Mick
opponents.meet_text: All I need is a bit of luck, I let that decide my fate. If I battle enough then I'm bound to win some of them at least.
opponents.repeat_text: I'll be a lot luckier this time round.
opponents.first_win_text: Luck really wasn't on my side today...
opponents.rematch_win_text: I just need a little bit of luck that's all.
opponents.loss_text: Looks like luck wasn't on your side today.

opponents.name: Fisherman Dave
opponents.meet_text: I love the lighthouse here, it seems to attract all kinds of fish so I always catch a lot in this spot. I'm catching so many I need a break.
opponents.repeat_text: I've caught a lot since last time.
opponents.first_win_text: Even if they don't help me win, I still love my fish.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Fishing and Pokemon cards are both a lot of fun, I could do both all day.
opponents.loss_text: Maybe you should try picking up a rod and give fishing a go instead!

opponents.name: Beach Kid Timothy
opponents.meet_text: I love the beach! I love the sand! I love building sandcastles! I love playing the Pokemon TCG!
opponents.repeat_text: I could build sandcastles and play Pokemon all day!
opponents.rematch_win_text: You can help me build a sandcastle if you want!

opponents.name: Beach Kid Evie
opponents.meet_text: I heard there's a scary Pokemon called Sandyghast. They sound scary and I don't like scary Pokemon, I only like cute pokemon!!
opponents.first_win_text: You haven't seen a Sandyghast have you?
opponents.rematch_win_text: If you see a Sandyghast please let me know!!

opponents.name: Birdspotter Tamsin
opponents.meet_text: These Palms attract a lot of Bird Pokemon so its a good spot to watch them.
opponents.repeat_text: Looking for more Birds round here?
opponents.first_win_text: I wish I could just fly away.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You can't fly away from all your troubles.
opponents.loss_text: You should try bird watching with me!

opponents.name: Swimmer Jordan
opponents.meet_text: I love the water, it's so calm and warm but my cards always get wet! I need to dry them off.
opponents.repeat_text: My friend has just arrived from Kanto and we're spending the day swimming together, but I can take a break for a rematch.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Nothing like a good match and a long swim.
opponents.loss_text: Maybe you should work on your swimming...

opponents.name: Bug Catcher Alex
opponents.meet_text: Some people hate bugs but I love them! Do you love bugs too?
opponents.repeat_text: You just love bugs as much as I do then?
opponents.first_win_text: Maybe bugs aren't as good as I thought...
opponents.rematch_win_text: Me and my bugs will win one of these days!
opponents.loss_text: I knew bugs were the best!!

opponents.name: Hiker Matthew
opponents.meet_text: I've been hiking for hours and only just managed to reach the harbour and found everything is closed so now I have nothing to do for the evening.
opponents.repeat_text: I'll be hiking back again tomorrow, I hike all day every day!
opponents.first_win_text: I should have just called it a night...
opponents.rematch_win_text: I could do with a long hike to get over this loss.

opponents.name: Young Twin Anna
opponents.meet_text: I've always wanted to play with Pokemon Cards and mummy finally got us some!
opponents.repeat_text: Yay we get to play again?
opponents.first_win_text: Oh nooooo, I really wanted to win.
opponents.loss_text: Yay!! mummy must have got us the best cards ever.

opponents.name: Young Twin Nella
opponents.meet_text: I've always wanted to play with Pokemon Cards and mummy finally got us some!
opponents.repeat_text: Yay we get to play again?
opponents.first_win_text: Oh nooooo, I really wanted to win.
opponents.loss_text: Yay!! mummy must have got us the best cards ever.

opponents.name: Bug Catcher Frankie
opponents.meet_text: Wow!!! The bugs here are so much cooler than what we have over in Viridian Forest!!
opponents.repeat_text: Seen any cool bug Pokemon around here since our last match?
opponents.first_win_text: My bugs clearly aren't as strong as the ones around here.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Hmm I wish I could get my hands on some of these bugs instead.
opponents.loss_text: Bug pokemon really aren't as weak as people think.

opponents.name: Guitarist Jonesy
opponents.meet_text: We're in a band and we're currently touring. We're just passing through to our next gig so having a quick jam here.
opponents.first_win_text: Damn I snapped a string while we were jamming.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You should come to one of our gigs!

opponents.name: Guitarist Howard
opponents.meet_text: We're the Toxtricity Rockers, we're a duo that's pretty big in Johto.
opponents.repeat_text: You here to hear a song or a rematch?
opponents.loss_text: If it's any consolation I'll give you a discount on our album.

opponents.name: Hiker Ben
opponents.meet_text: Well that's incredibly disappointing. I was hoping to have a trek through the forest but they've told me it's shut so I have nowhere to go now.
opponents.repeat_text: The forest has to be open soon surely.
opponents.first_win_text: Well that's another disappointment to my day.
opponents.loss_text: At least that's given me a nice little boost after the bad news.

opponents.name: Card Elder Hamish
opponents.meet_text: Back for the challenge then hey? Remember you'll need to defeat all 3 of us if you want to progress.
opponents.repeat_text: Very well, I always enjoy a good challenge!
opponents.first_win_text: Well done, that was quite the battle. Take my medal and continue forth.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Battling like this makes me feel young again.
opponents.loss_text: Don't be disheartened, the rain will always stop.

opponents.name: Card Elder Rayne
opponents.meet_text: Hoh Hoh, are you ready to feel the torrent? If you win I'll give you a medal to prove your triumph.
opponents.repeat_text: Hoh Hoh! I enjoyed the battle that much I'd also like another!
opponents.first_win_text: Congratulations on your win. You've earned this medal and my respect.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Come back any time and battle us old folk.
opponents.loss_text: Don't be disheartened, the rain will always stop.

opponents.name: Card Elder Waverly
opponents.meet_text: Are you ready to take me on then? If you win then you'll do well in the Gym Hero Challenge.
opponents.repeat_text: Up for another round then? Happy to oblige.
opponents.first_win_text: Well well well, what a jolly good play! You've earned this.
opponents.rematch_win_text: We've been winning and losing for so long it's always fun either way.
opponents.loss_text: When you fail, get up and try again.

opponents.name: Tourist Alissa
opponents.meet_text: Nothing feels better than the sand beneath your toes after being stuck in your cabin for days on end.
opponents.repeat_text: I'm so relaxed I could stay here all day.
opponents.first_win_text: Have you ever been on a cruise before?
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'll have to practice more when I'm back on board.
opponents.loss_text: Oh wonderful! I do love it when I win!

opponents.name: Tourist Edmund
opponents.meet_text: I live in Celadon City so it's rare I get to the beach. I'm here to make the most of it.
opponents.repeat_text: It won't feel like that long before we have to head onwards.
opponents.first_win_text: I'm not here to win, only here for a good time.
opponents.rematch_win_text: You're the best player I've battled around here.
opponents.loss_text: I didn't even mean to win so that's a nice surprise.
